lines: 十七章走完，这一集不引入新论文，只做收束。
Seventeen chapters done. This finale adds no new papers.
先用一张图，把前面所有章节串成一条链。
First, one map that strings every chapter into a chain.
再用十条定律，讲清这条链上反复出现的模式。
Then ten laws that keep recurring along that chain.
最后是下一步：读什么，做什么，还有什么没答案。
Then what to read, what to build, what stays open.
这一章没有新知识，只有重新排列过的旧知识。
No new knowledge here, only old knowledge rearranged.
如果只记一句话：能力来自规模，可用性来自对齐，边界来自评测与可解释性。
One sentence: ability from scale, usability from alignment, limits from testing.
整门课只有一个目标：给定上下文，预测下一个词。
The whole course has one goal: predict the next token.
手段也只有一个：梯度下降加反向传播，把损失压下去。
One method: gradient descent plus backprop, pushing loss down.
围绕这个目标，长出三根支柱：表示、架构、数据。
Three pillars grow around it: representation, architecture, data.
表示把词变成向量，架构用注意力，数据来自互联网。
Vectors, attention, and text from the internet.
三根支柱合起来，才有规模化：损失按幂律下降。
Together they scale: loss falls as a power law.
规模之后分出三个方向：对齐、推理、效率。
Then three branches: alignment, reasoning, efficiency.
对齐让它可用，推理让它多想几步，效率让它跑得起。
Alignment makes it usable; reasoning makes it think longer.
最后接到外部世界：检索、工具、评测，直到智能体。
Finally it meets the world: retrieval, tools, evaluation, agents.
十条定律不是物理定律，而是贯穿全课的模式。
These are not physics laws, but patterns that recur.
第一条：目标越简单，就越容易规模化。
Law one: the simpler the target, the easier to scale.
简单目标加海量数据，胜过精巧目标加少量数据。
Simple targets with massive data beat clever targets with little data.
第二条：表示决定上限，模型学不到表示之外。
Law two: representation sets the ceiling.
只给词编号学不到相似，静态词向量学不到语境。
Raw IDs cannot see similarity; static vectors cannot see context.
所以每次架构革命，本质上都是一次表示革命。
Every architecture revolution was a representation revolution.
第三条：注意力是可微检索，深度是串行计算。
Law three: attention is differentiable retrieval, depth is serial compute.
自回归把时间变成计算，三件事拼成会思考的近似。
Autoregression turns time into compute: an engineering approximation of thought.
第四条：规模有定律，但定律也有边界。
Law four: scaling has laws, and the laws have limits.
损失随规模按幂律下降，可预测，也可规划。
Loss falls as a power law, predictable and plannable.
但数据会枯竭，推理成本上升，收益递减。
But data runs dry, inference costs rise, returns diminish.
第五条：对齐是分布偏移，不是知识注入。
Law five: alignment shifts a distribution, it does not inject knowledge.
它只把概率质量，从人类不喜欢挪到人类喜欢。
It moves probability mass from disliked to liked.
所以对齐改得了风格行为，改不了知识边界。
So alignment changes style and behavior, not the knowledge boundary.
第六条：推理可以写进权重，也可以花在推理时。
Law six: reasoning can live in weights, or be spent at inference.
给定预算，要在训练更久和想更久之间分配。
Given a budget, choose between training longer and thinking longer.
第七条：稀疏是效率问题最通用的解法。
Law seven: sparsity is the general answer for efficiency.
混合专家、稀疏缓存、稀疏特征，大脑也稀疏放电。
Mixture of experts, sparse caches, sparse features, even neurons.
用结构化的稀疏，逼近稠密计算的效果。
Structured sparsity approximates dense compute.
第八条：记忆必须分层，而且要分得清楚。
Law eight: memory must be layered.
权重是长期，上下文是短期，外部库无限可溯源。
Weights are long-term, context is short-term, external stores are unbounded.
第九条：评测是能力的代理，代理会被优化。
Law nine: evaluation is a proxy, and proxies get optimized.
基准会污染，评审会带偏见，榜单会谄媚。
Benchmarks leak, judges are biased, leaderboards flatter.
唯一可靠的评测，是持续更新题目、多指标、真实任务。
Only refreshed tasks, many metrics, and real work stay honest.
第十条：可靠性等于单步可靠，乘上步数。
Law ten: reliability is single-step reliability times steps.
单步零点九五，走二十步，只剩约百分之三十六。
0.95 per step, twenty steps, about 36 percent left.
长链条的可靠性，由最弱环节和长度共同决定。
Long chains fail at the weakest link and the length.
不要追求永不犯错，要设计成错了能发现。
Do not aim for never wrong; design for detection.
发现之后，还要能回滚到一个安全的状态。
Detection, and rollback.
如果十条定律还是太重，那就只记三件事。
If ten laws are still too much, keep three things.
第一，它是一个概率模型，不是一个知识库。
One: it is a probability model, not a knowledge base.
它的能力与缺陷，都来自根据上文预测下一个词。
Its powers and flaws come from predicting the next token.
第二，能力来自规模，可用性来自对齐。
Two: capability from scale, usability from alignment.
产品化的关键，常是把任务拆对，把上下文给对。
Ship by splitting tasks well and feeding context well.
第三，它没有理解的保证，只有表现的证据。
Three: no guarantee of understanding, only evidence of behavior.
思维链可能不忠实，注意力图可能不解释，要验证。
Chains of thought may be unfaithful; verify, do not trust.
想读论文，从入门五篇开始，按这个顺序。
To read papers, start with five, in this order.
二零一七年 Transformer 架构，二零二零年 GPT-3 规模。
2017, Transformer, architecture; 2020, GPT-3, scale.
二零二二年有两篇：一篇讲对齐，一篇讲思维链。
2022 brought two: alignment, and chain of thought.
二零二五年的 DeepSeek-R1，讲用强化学习换推理。
2025, DeepSeek-R1, trading reinforcement learning for reasoning.
读法是先摘要、图一、结论，再方法，最后实验。
Read abstract, figure one, conclusion; then method; then experiments.
不要从头读到尾，那是审稿人的读法，不是学习者的。
Not cover to cover. That is a reviewer's habit, not a learner's.
想动手的话，有五件事，都从小模型开始。
To build, five exercises, all on small models.
先用十亿参数以下的模型，跑通分词、前向、采样。
First, run tokenize, forward, sample under one billion parameters.
再写二十行最小的注意力，确认缩放点积。
Then write twenty lines of attention and check the scaled dot product.
用 LoRA 微调一个分类任务，感受预训练加微调。
Fine-tune a classifier with LoRA to feel pretraining plus tuning.
搭一个最小 RAG：切块、嵌入、检索、拼提示。
Build a minimal RAG: chunk, embed, retrieve, prompt.
最后用 ReAct 写个会查天气的智能体，看它怎么失败。
Then a ReAct agent that checks weather, and watch it fail.
最后是开放问题，它们目前都没有答案。
Finally, open questions, all without answers.
第一，规模还会继续有效吗，数据墙之后靠什么。
One: does scale keep working after the data wall?
第二，推理的本质是什么，思维链是真的在想吗。
Two: what is reasoning, and is a chain of thought really thinking?
第三，如何保证对齐，模型能假装对齐怎么办。
Three: how to ensure alignment when a model can fake it?
第四，智能体可靠吗，复合误差能不能压下去。
Four: are agents reliable, can compound error be pressed down?
还有理解与预测的边界，以及能源与算力的极限。
Also the boundary of understanding, and the limits of energy and compute.
历史上，我们总是先有工程近似，再用它定义问题。
History shows we build an approximation, then let it define the question.
模型可能不是智能的答案，但它是目前最好的探针。
A model may not be the answer to intelligence, but it is the best probe.
回到第 1 章那个四词表：猫零点六，狗零点三。
Back to chapter one: cat 0.6, dog 0.3.
它和今天几千亿参数的模型，在数学上是同一件事。
Today's hundred-billion-parameter models do the same math.
说到底，就是先给一个分布，然后再采样。
Give a distribution, then sample.
差别只在规模、数据、对齐，和我们围绕它建的工程。
Only scale, data, alignment, and the engineering around it differ.
一个简单到能写进一行的目标，长出了没人能完全解释的能力。
A target one line long grew abilities nobody fully explains.
理解它这件事，不需要膜拜，也不需要恐惧。
Understanding it needs neither worship nor fear.
你只需要一层层拆开，再一层层装回去。
Just take it apart layer by layer, and put it back.
这门课讲到这里，就真的走到最后一页了。
This course ends here.
你带走的不该是结论，而是一套拆装的工具。
What you take is not conclusions, but a set of tools.
下一步：读一篇论文，跑一次前向，写一个智能体。
Next: read a paper, run a forward pass, build an agent.
保持怀疑：分数是代理，解释是证据，不是保证。
Stay skeptical: scores are proxies, explanations are evidence, not guarantees.
剩下的那些问题，就是你自己的问题了。
The rest is your own question now.
